text:
samira: starting phased deploy to prod-eu2 -> v2.14.0-rc3 (commit abcdf1234). change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. release notes: quick perf improvements to KV cache + batching. @kevin can you watch canary?

deploy-bot: [deploy-job] started deploy job id=job-2256-prod-eu2 tag=v2.14.0-rc3 commit=abcdf1234

kevin: seeing a small 5-8% 503 spike on router-a canary at t+3m, latency up ~120ms. sample logs below:
```
2026-03-20T02:03:12Z router-a 503 "KV cache miss"
```

oncall-bot: alert: error-rate > 4% (threshold 3%) on prod-eu2-canary. Incident auto-ticket: INC-2026-045 created.

samira: pausing rollout. initiating rollback to last stable tag v2.13.7. executing pin and rollback now. @maria please prep customer note.

deploy-bot: [rollback-job] rollback initiated to tag=v2.13.7 commit=9a8b7c6 started_by=samira job=rb-2256-001 env=prod-eu2 reason="canary 503 spike" instructions: "pin v2.13.7 and stop traffic to rc3"

kevin: running pin command:
`deployctl pin --env prod-eu2 --tag v2.13.7 --reason "post-canary rollback"`
will also scale down rc3 canary pods.

maria: updating status page draft, will publish in 10m. also adding a short note to release notes: "rc3 rolled back due to canary error spike; no customer data impact."

deploy-bot: [rollback-job] completed SUCCESS job=rb-2256-001 duration=4m12s reverted_to=9a8b7c6 pinned_tag=v2.13.7 traffic=100% -> v2.13.7

samira: thanks. logging this for postmortem. next steps: run smoke CI against rc3 with `--kv-cache=off` and compare. creating follow-up ticket: RH-2026-78. link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-guideline

kevin: adding notes to changelog and will investigate diff in kernel selection path that might affect router-A.

maria: status page updated: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-045 :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-045 set to resolved (rollback succeeded). please file RCA within 72h.
